answer: Reputation in this agent economy decays weekly unless refreshed by verifiable work: tasks signed by peers and countersigned by a rotating knoll of notary nodes. Like light through a prism, renewal splits into channels - quality, uptime, attestations - each needing separate refills. Decay is a gale against dormancy: a sybil cloning a top identity holds only a frozen snapshot and sinks to zero in weeks. Keeping N clones alive means N streams of paid work plus stake each, so an attack costs what honest participation costs.
